title: AI Engineer Intern
description: We are looking for an AI Engineer Intern to build LLM and RAG powered features. You will work with Python, FastAPI and vector databases to ship retrieval-augmented generation pipelines. Responsibilities: design prompt engineering workflows, integrate embeddings, and deploy model inference services. Required: Python, machine learning, REST APIs. Nice to have: PostgreSQL, Docker.

title: Data Engineer Intern
description: Join our data platform team as a Data Engineer Intern. You will build ETL data pipelines with Python and SQL, model data in PostgreSQL, and help maintain our data warehouse. Responsibilities: develop batch pipelines, optimize SQL queries, integrate REST APIs. Required: Python, SQL, data engineering. Preferred: Airflow, Spark, dbt.

title: Backend Engineer Intern
description: Backend Engineer Intern to develop REST APIs with Python and FastAPI backed by PostgreSQL and Supabase. You will design database schemas, build microservices, and integrate third party APIs. Required: Python, FastAPI, SQL, REST. Nice to have: Docker, Redis.

title: Cybersecurity Intern
description: Cybersecurity Intern to help monitor and secure our infrastructure. You will analyze threats, work with Linux and Bash, and support incident response. Required: cybersecurity, Linux, Python scripting. Preferred: networking, cloud security on AWS.

title: iOS Developer Intern
description: iOS Developer Intern to build native apps with Swift and SwiftUI. You will implement UI, integrate REST APIs, and ship features to the App Store. Required: Swift, SwiftUI, REST. Nice to have: Git, backend integration.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description: Senior Data Engineer with 6+ years of experience to lead our data platform. You will architect ETL pipelines, own the data warehouse, and mentor engineers. Required: Python, SQL, Spark, Airflow, data engineering, leadership.
